title: In 1859, the Sun Set Telegraph Paper on Fire
caption: In September 1859, a solar storm made telegraph wires spark, lit auroras as far south as Cuba and Panama, and let operators send messages with their batteries unplugged. #carringtonevent #solarstorm #history #mystery #science #space #shorts
